headline: Everything you need to launch.
note: You launch it. Our brokers do the work.

linkedin:
Launching a new benefit should not mean more work for HR.

When you sign up to Get Perks, you get everything you need to put it in front of your people:

A co-branded portal with your logo on it.
A launch pack with posters, intranet copy and email templates.
On-site adviser days, so your people can put a face to the service.
Anonymised reporting, so you can see how the benefit is used without seeing anyone's personal details.

Then our brokers do the work, not your team.
